en_title: Capcom Clarifies Stance on AI After RE Engine Conference Comments
cn_title: 卡普空澄清RE引擎的AI使用计划
subtitle: 只用于辅助开发
opus_summary: 卡普空向IGN澄清，计划通过REX逐步改进RE引擎，用AI工具协助开发团队提高效率。公司表示，不打算用生成式AI制作游戏，也不会将AI生成的素材用于游戏，并将继续探索AI在开发流程中的用途。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil and Street Fighter developer Capcom has clarified its stance on AI and its future plans for the RE Engine in an exclusive conversation with IGN.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》和《街头霸王》的开发商卡普空在接受IGN独家采访时，澄清了公司对AI的态度，以及RE引擎的未来规划。

paragraphs.en: Capcom held its yearly recruitment conference on October 2, wherein programmer Satoshi Ishida outlined the company’s plans to incrementally improve its RE Engine using a program called REX (short for RE Next Engine).
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空于10月2日举行年度招聘说明会。程序员石田聪在会上介绍了公司的计划：通过名为REX（RE Next Engine的缩写）的项目，逐步改进RE引擎。

paragraphs.en: Rather than building a new engine from scrap, Ishida explained that a series of steps will be taken to improve the RE Engine piece by piece. This includes the use of AI, which gave fans pause after the news broke online.
paragraphs.cn: 石田聪解释称，卡普空不会从零打造新引擎，而是会分阶段逐步改进RE引擎。其中包括使用AI；消息传到网上后，这一点让粉丝感到担忧。

paragraphs.en: We bent the ear of a spokesperson at Capcom, who laid out the challenges its developers are currently facing that led the company to rethink how it makes games with the RE Engine. They confirmed that games are becoming increasingly colossal undertakings, to the point where titles now take up immense amounts of time and resources to create. With AI being a swiftly-advancing technology, Capcom saw the opportunity to use it to solve these issues and make its developers more efficient by improving their development tools, testing game code for them, and analyzing large chunks of data on their behalf, as well as other helpful benefits.
paragraphs.cn: 我们向卡普空发言人询问了此事。对方介绍了开发团队目前面临的挑战，以及这些挑战为何促使公司重新考虑如何使用RE引擎制作游戏。发言人证实，游戏开发的规模越来越大，如今制作一款游戏需要投入大量时间和资源。AI技术发展迅速，卡普空认为可以借此应对这些问题：用AI改进开发工具、协助测试游戏代码、分析大量数据，并以其他方式帮助开发团队提高效率。

paragraphs.en: Capcom’s vision for REX is to implement these AI tools and efficiencies into the next iteration of the RE Engine to help the company make games faster with the strongest tools available to it. The spokesperson told us that Capcom has no plans to use generative AI in the creation of its games (which creates content based on a prompt, as opposed to other types of AI that are used to analyze patterns, make predictions, process data, etc.). Any AI used with the RE Engine will be for the express purpose of speeding up processes and helping development teams be more efficient.
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空希望通过REX，在下一代RE引擎中引入这些AI工具和提升效率的做法，让公司利用现有的最强工具加快游戏开发。发言人告诉我们，卡普空没有在游戏制作中使用生成式AI的计划。生成式AI会根据提示词生成内容，与用于分析规律、作出预测或处理数据等用途的其他AI不同。RE引擎中使用AI，目的只会是加快开发流程、提高团队效率。

paragraphs.en: This means that AI will not be used for creating assets or programs in games. Capcom said as much back in March during a shareholders’ meeting , where the company was asked how it intends to use artificial intelligence in its products.
paragraphs.cn: 也就是说，卡普空不会用AI制作游戏中的素材或程序。今年3月，卡普空在股东大会上被问及打算如何在产品中使用AI时，就曾表达过这一立场。

paragraphs.en: “We will not implement assets generated by AI into our games.” Capcom said. “However, we plan to proactively use it as a contributing technology to improve the efficiency and productivity of the game development process. To this end, we are currently exploring ways to implement it in various areas, including graphics, sound and programming."
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空当时表示：「我们不会在游戏中使用AI生成的素材。不过，我们计划积极将AI作为辅助技术，用来提高游戏开发流程的效率和产出。为此，我们正在探索如何在图形、声音和编程等多个领域使用AI。」

paragraphs.en: Upcoming Capcom games include Resident Evil Veronica and Mega Man: Dual Override.
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空即将推出的游戏包括《生化危机 维罗妮卡 重制版》和《Mega Man: Dual Override》。
